description: Google's Noto fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1) for the SelectPdf.Universal and SelectPdf.HtmlToPdf.Universal libraries: Sans, Serif and Mono for every script Noto covers - Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Arabic, Hebrew, the Indic and Southeast Asian scripts, Georgian, Armenian, Ethiopic, Tibetan and more - plus Noto Sans CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean; Regular and Bold) and Noto Color Emoji. The fonts are copied to a fonts folder next to your application, where the Chromium engine and the library find them, so text in any language renders on a Linux or macOS host with no fonts installed (Docker images, AWS Lambda, Azure App Service Linux, Google Cloud Run). They are not copied for Windows targets, which have these fonts already. 272 font files, about 92 MB.
summary: Noto fonts for every script, used by SelectPdf on hosts with no fonts installed.
title: SelectPdf Fonts for Linux and macOS (Noto, every script)
